text: Therefore, the category of the five subtle elements (tanmātras) arises from the primordial being (bhūtādi). Moreover, because the dual nature of the fiery (taijasa) and the dark (tamasī) is overcome by the luminous (sattva), the ego (ahaṃkāra) is designated as fiery (taijasa). Consequently, the dual nature of the fiery and the dark arises from it.
